acceptance.rawContract: Six exact direct Logs requests and complete responses confirm corrected display matching, rejected spurious suffix, unchanged controls and default/explicit raw matching.
acceptance.public: Running endpoint returned200 with qa-a869-healthy newline; deleted endpoint returned404.

captureNotes: Native response observers do not intercept, rewrite, delay or synthesize product requests or messages.

Two ancillary build/app Logs requests occur during the desktop ASCII filter interval without text variables. Do not infer that every deploy local-search interval is network silent.

The inspected local mobile PNG shows the header and query bar; the matching row is below its nested scroll viewport. The durable row-text/ARIA and native API captures support row-content claims, not that PNG.
An initial mobile filter helper raised ReferenceError before dispatch because of a lost harness closure; the repaired self-contained helper produced the recorded successful actions.

Network summary includes navigation/connection aborts without a reproduced functional failure. HTTP200 transport alone is not treated as GraphQL success; complete targeted response bodies are retained.
Original a735 evidence is preserved byte-for-byte with its sha256 recorded below.
unverified: Future-only SSE new arrivals (Live-on acceptance searches existing stored records)
Actual Postgres/Key Value or sibling service-family records
Grapheme clusters and terminal column width
